notes_for_editor: Thin record. NHLR is the only tower-specific source: site description, elevation, registry number, registration date and administrator. Conflict to check: the same NHLR entry uses present tense for the tower yet calls its site a former Division of Forestry site, and the sources read do not say whether the tower itself remains as described. The Forest Lookouts page is a stub with name and county only. No build year, designer, staffing, fire history, access or rental information was found; the NHLR Florida index has no rental or visit data for this tower. Wikidata has a bare label only. The Scribd history is general context and does not name Homosassa. Tampa Bay Times and Lakeland Ledger tower articles returned empty or HTTP 403, so they were not used. Recommend a Citrus County or Florida Forest Service check of the current condition before any status is assigned. Fact-check 2026-10-09: status moved from standing to unknown because the register never uses the word standing.
